EmailTemplate.description: For use by the Admission Services App Services team
EmailTemplate.name: Transfer Credit Inquiry (Advisor - Resolved)
EmailTemplate.subject: Your transfer credit inquiry is complete
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Hello {!Contact.FirstName},
Thank you for contacting Arizona State University’s Admission Services about your student’s transfer credits. We have resolved the transfer credit issue in our system. It may take up to five business days for the change to appear in the student’s DARS audit report.
If after five days the change does not appear in the DARS audit report, you may need to reach out to the Academic Articulation department at articulation@asu.edu or University Registrar Services at courses@asu.edu.
Thank you,
Admission Services transfercredit@asu.edu
If you would like any additional information or have questions related to this subject, please reply to this email.
{!Case.Thread_Id}
